# `FluxHostApi::write_error`

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Reports one human-readable startup error message back to the host.

## Signature

```rust
fn write_error (& self , message : & str) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

## Arguments

| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | & str | `message` argument passed as `& str`. |

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxhostapi-write-error.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxhostapi-write-error.md)_

```rust
fn report_startup_error(host: &FluxHostApi, message: &str) -> FluxStatus {
    match host.write_error(message) {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
